notes.title: Version 1.6
notes.content:
Hello Gamers
Made some much needed fixes today!

So, Haha today has been fun and I've learned a lot about publishing on Steam and exporting with Godot 4.3.

I've Fixed and added few things so here goes:

Bug - Players getting stuck on fences on Level-2 and onwards
Bug - Completing the games main ending would leave you in a white void forever 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fix - Fences Collision is turned off so it is no longer possible for the player to get stuck and soft lock there game

Fix - The "Cycle Ending" will now take you back to the first level of the game (Resetting the run)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Thank you all for being very patient. :) 

Also , if its saying an error of "Couldn't find Tower Of Lies 1.2.exe"
Verify your files and it'll work :)

kk that's all I've done for today....... Oh yeah, I also made Szechuan chicken too
